about:
Furniture Classics operates from a 10,000-square-foot showroom at 433 West 5th Avenue in Anchorage, Alaska. The business traces its roots to the late 1950s when Anchorage pioneer Helen Calrquist opened Eckman's on 4th Avenue. After a bank takeover, she relocated to 5th Avenue. The store later became Nerland's Home Furnishings under the Nerland family, with longtime sales associate Erma Howell. In 1989, Howell partnered with current owner Colleen Hickey to establish Furniture Classics. The company is woman-owned.

As a furniture retailer and interior design studio, Furniture Classics offers a rotating inventory of American-made furniture, custom orders with over 2,000 fabric options, interior design services (many complimentary), white-glove delivery and installation across Anchorage and surrounding areas, and furniture assembly. The showroom spans 10,000 square feet and carries pieces in solid walnut, maple, cherry, leather, and velvet. Financing is available with 18 months deferred interest on purchases over $1,500.

The company serves residential customers throughout Alaska, including homeowners in Anchorage, Girdwood, Eagle River, and the Matanuska-Susitna Valley. Interior design clients range from individuals seeking full-room designs to those needing single-piece consultations. They also cater to customers looking for custom-made furniture and one-of-a-kind pieces sourced from national markets such as High Point.

Furniture Classics' stated mission is to provide quality American-made furniture to Alaskans at an affordable price without sacrificing comfort or style. The team emphasizes its 35-plus years of industry experience, which allows it to curate durable, high-quality brands and avoid lower-quality imitations. Designers help clients navigate thousands of fabric and style options to create functional, beautiful spaces.
